This agent is intended for project-specific work in the BFS Compliance repository.

Use this agent when you need help with:
- FastAPI API routes, endpoints, and request/response design
- Domain-driven design contexts for Policy, Audit, and Regulation
- Retrieval-augmented generation pipeline, chunking, reranking, retrieval, and citation handling
- Evaluation workflows, golden set scoring, and trust/human approval controls
- Project documentation, ADRs, and failure-mode analysis

Prefer repository-local context and project files. Avoid generic AI development advice that is not grounded in this codebase.
